summary: Local CI script tests use a short independent Watchman fixture socket path, and report commands use the running Python when HOME hides the caller's profile.

schema.detail: No storage or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Report commands prepend a private directory containing only a python3 symlink to the trusted running interpreter. It is removed with run scratch. Canonical check PATH, report argv and evidence policy remain unchanged; interpreter sibling tools are not admitted.

compatibility.detail: Existing report commands and signed evidence keep their portable command names.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous local test and toolchain lookup behavior; no data recovery is needed.
